title: Windmill with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- ground / hill -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="92" rx="48" ry="14" fill="#6dcf6d"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="94" rx="40" ry="10" fill="#58b858"/>

  <!-- windmill tower -->
  <path d="M38 88 L42 42 L58 42 L62 88 Z" fill="#f2e3c2"/>
  <path d="M38 88 L42 42 L50 42 L50 88 Z" fill="#e6d3a8"/>

  <!-- tower door -->
  <path d="M45 88 L45 72 Q50 66 55 72 L55 88 Z" fill="#b07a4a"/>
  <path d="M45 88 L45 72 Q48 68 50 68 L50 88 Z" fill="#96663c"/>

  <!-- little window -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="56" r="4" fill="#8fd8ff"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="56" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#c9a86a" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- happy face on the tower -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="48" r="1.8" fill="#5a3a1a"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="48" r="1.8" fill="#5a3a1a"/>
  <path d="M44 51 Q50 56 56 51" fill="none" stroke="#5a3a1a" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- roof hub -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="6" fill="#d94f4f"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="3" fill="#f27c7c"/>

  <!-- blades (4) -->
  <g>
    <!-- blade 1 up -->
    <rect x="47.5" y="8" width="5" height="28" rx="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <rect x="47.5" y="8" width="2.5" height="28" fill="#dfe9f2"/>
    <line x1="47.5" y1="14" x2="52.5" y2="14" stroke="#9fb8cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="47.5" y1="21" x2="52.5" y2="21" stroke="#9fb8cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="47.5" y1="28" x2="52.5" y2="28" stroke="#9fb8cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- blade 2 right -->
    <rect x="64" y="35.5" width="28" height="5" rx="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <rect x="64" y="38" width="28" height="2.5" fill="#dfe9f2"/>
    <line x1="70" y1="35.5" x2="70" y2="40.5" stroke="#9fb8cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="77" y1="35.5" x2="77" y2="40.5" stroke="#9fb8cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="84" y1="35.5" x2="84" y2="40.5" stroke="#9fb8cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- blade 3 down -->
    <rect x="47.5" y="64" width="5" height="28" rx="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <rect x="47.5" y="64" width="2.5" height="28" fill="#dfe9f2"/>
    <line x1="47.5" y1="70" x2="52.5" y2="70" stroke="#9fb8cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="47.5" y1="77" x2="52.5" y2="77" stroke="#9fb8cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="47.5" y1="84" x2="52.5" y2="84" stroke="#9fb8cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- blade 4 left -->
    <rect x="8" y="35.5" width="28" height="5" rx="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <rect x="8" y="38" width="28" height="2.5" fill="#dfe9f2"/>
    <line x1="14" y1="35.5" x2="14" y2="40.5" stroke="#9fb8cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="21" y1="35.5" x2="21" y2="40.5" stroke="#9fb8cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="28" y1="35.5" x2="28" y2="40.5" stroke="#9fb8cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- tiny grass tufts -->
  <path d="M20 90 Q22 84 24 90" fill="none" stroke="#3fa03f" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M72 90 Q74 85 76 90" fill="none" stroke="#3fa03f" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M30 93 Q32 88 34 93" fill="none" stroke="#3fa03f" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
